title: ZnS QDs and Nanomaterials Research
summary: This cluster revolves around the research on ZnS quantum dots (QDs) and nanomaterials. The ZnS QDs are manufactured by IMEM-CNR and have been characterized using dynamic light scattering. They are exposed to various organisms, including yeast strains and wild-type, and induce the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and cell death. The nanomaterials have been published by several researchers, including Guisbiers Gregory, Luche Sophia, Marmiroli Marta, Marmiroli Nelson, and Pagano Luca. The ZnS QDs also interact with specific genes and proteins, such as pos5Δ and glr1Δ, and modulate the function of mitochondrion.
